notes.title: Spacebus is Evolving - Now Releasing Summer 2021
notes.content:
[h2]Spacebus is Evolving![/h2]

As Spacebus continues to grow, we've added tons of new features that vastly improve the gameplay.
For example:
[list]
[*] Full Story Mode
[*] Multiple Ship Layouts
[*] UX Overhaul of the Central Game Mechanics
[*] Cutscenes
[*] And more!
[/list]
We're almost finished adding these new changes, but we want to give ourselves enough time to properly test and market this game before release. 

Stay tuned for more updates as we get closer to launch!
[i]-Incredulous Devs[/i]
